newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Stainless to raise pipe prices.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Stainless to raise pipe prices.

text.p: Consolidated Stainless Inc said Tuesday it will increase its prices on stainless steel pipe by about 10 percent, effective November 11.
President Ronald Adams said in a statement that move should have a "direct effect on improving our profit margins.
Adams said that the company believes the "period of depressed prices and squeezed margins in the stainless steel industry is ending."
He added that the full effect of the price increase will not be felt until next year, since the increase will not take place until midway through its 1996 fourth quarter.
The company said it decided to raise prices, after a period of declining prices that lasted more than a year, because the market had begun turning around.
